📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 abs_ret：close.pct_change().abs()
  4. 计算 vol_trend：vol_ratio - 1.0
  5. 计算 stress：abs_ret * vol_trend
  6. 计算 stress_accum：stress.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  7. 计算 vol_60：returns.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).std()
  8. 计算 factor：stress_accum / vol_60
  9. 计算 factor：factor.where(np.isfinite(factor), 0.0)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_trend_stress_volscaled_v2(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] abs_ret = close.pct_change().abs() is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20) vol_trend = vol_ratio - 1.0 stress = abs_ret * vol_trend stress_accum = stress.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() returns = close.pct_change() vol_60 = returns.rolling(60, min_periods=60).std() factor = stress_accum / vol_60.replace(0.0, np.nan) factor = factor.where(np.isfinite(factor), 0.0) factor.name = "str">'factor_volume_trend_stress_volscaled_v2' "kw">class="kw">return factor
